tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅// nag po pa'i sgrub thabs kyi sa bcad bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ rje btsun bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// slob dpon spyod pa bas mdzad pa'i dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub thabs 'di la gnyis/ klad kyi don dang*/ gzhung ngo*// dang po la gnyis/ phyag btsal ba dang*/ bshad par dam bca' ba'o// gzhung la gnyis/ mnyam par gzhag pa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ mnyam langs so// dang po la gnyis/ bskyed pa'i rim pa dang*/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i rgyas gdab pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ rgyu tshogs bsag pa dang*/ 'bras bu lha bskyed pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsag pa dang*/ ye shes kyi tshogs bsag pa'o// 'bras bu lhar bskyed pa la gnyis/ rten bskyed pa dang*/ brten pa lha bskyed pa'o// rten bskyed pa la gnyis/ srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa dang*/ gzhal yas khang bsgom pa'o// brten pa lha bskyed pa la gsum/ dang po sbyor ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dang*/ las rgyal mchog go /dang po sbyor ba la bzhi/ bsnyen pa dang*/ nye bar sgrub pa dang*/ sgrub pa dang*/ sgrub pa chen po'o// dang po la gnyis/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa bskyed pa dang*/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa bzhengs pa'o// de la bzhi/ snyoms par 'jug pa las 'od du zhu ba dang*/ glus bskul ba dang*/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin par bzhengs pa dngos dang*/ de brten pa'i yan lag tu byin gyis brlab pa'o// nye bar sgrub pa la gnyis/ dpa' bo'i go cha dang*/ dpa' mo'i go cha'o// sgrub pa la gsum/ yab byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ yum byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ rang byin gyis brlab pa'o// sgrub pa chen po la bzhi/ ye shes pa dgug pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba dang*/ mchod pa dang*/ mkha' gsang byin gyis brlab pa'o// dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog la bzhi/ dam tshig pa bskyed pa dang*/ ye shes pa gzhug pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba dang*/ mchod pa bya ba'o// dang po la bzhi/ de bzhin gshegs pa spyan drang ba dang*/

'od du zhu ba dang*/ lha rnams bskyed pa dang*/ so sor bstim zhing dgod pa'o// de la gnyis/ bstim pa dang*/ dgod pa'o// de la bzhi/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o// spyi'i mtshan nyid dang*/ lha rnams kyi rigs so// dang po la gsum/ bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo la dgod pa dang*/ 'khor lo gsum gyi lha phyi dang nang du dgod pa dag pa dang bcas pa dang*/ sgo mtshams ma dgod pa'o// bar pa la gsum/ thugs kyi 'khor lo dang*/ gsung gi dang*/ sku'i'o// spyi'i mtshan nyid la gnyis/ 'khor lo spyi'i mtshan nyid la sogs pa dang*/ khyad par du sgo mtshams rnams kyi'o// las rgyal mchog ni byang chub kyi phyogs kyi dag pa dran pa yin par dbye ba med/ mnyam gzhag gi spyi don gnyis pa'i rim pa la gnyis/ dpyid kyi thig ler 'khor lo gnyis kyi mnyam par gzhag pa dang*/ 'khor lo bzhi'i rnam par gzhag pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ dpyid kyi thig le'i rten dang*/ brten pa rlung gi mtshan nyid do// 'khor lo bzhi'i rnam par gzhag pa la gnyis/ 'khor lo bzhi spyi'i mtshan nyid dang*/ khyad par snying ga'i rnam par gzhag pa'o// mnyam langs la gsum/ gtor ma dang*/ bzlas pa dang*/ langs te spyod lam gyi dus su go cha bgo ba'o// dang po la gsum/ gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ gtor ma'i phan yon dang*/ gtor ma'i sngags so// bzlas pa la lnga/ rtsa ba'i sngags dang*/ 'khor lo lnga'i sngags dang*/ yab kyi snying po dang*/ nye snying dang*/ zhal bzhi pa dang*/ yum gyi snying po dang*/ nye snying dang*/ nye ba'i snying po'o// nag po mngon par rtogs pa'i bsdus pa'i don dge bsnyen grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis sbyar ba'o// // ༄༅// nag po pa'i sbyin sreg gi sa bcad bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ rje btsun bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// slob dpon spyod pa bas mdzad pa'i sbyin sreg la don gsum/ klad kyi don dang*/ gzhung dang*/ mjug go /dang po la gnyis/

shis par brjod pa dang*/ bshad par dam bca' ba'o// gzhung la gnyis/ sbyin sreg gi dus dang*/ dgos pa bstan pa dang*/ sbyin sreg dngos so// de la gnyis/ mdor bstan cing gzhan dag la zur za ba dang*/ so sor rgyas par bstan pa'o// de la bzhi/ bla na med pa dang*/ nang gi sbyin sreg dang*/ spyi'i mtshan nyid dang*/ phyi'i sbyin sreg go /dang po la gsum/ mtshon bya bla na med pa'i sbyin sreg dang*/ de mtshon byed bla na med pa'i sbyin sreg dang*/ slob dpon gzhan dang mthun par bstan pa'o// phyi'i sbyin sreg la gnyis/ bshad par dam bca' ba dang*/ phyi'i sbyin sreg dngos so// de la gsum/ sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ mjug go /dang po la bcu/ thab khung gi mtshan nyid dang*/ me pra la sogs pa gzhung gzhan nas kha 'phangs pa dang*/ rgyud gzhan nas bshad pa dang*/ man ngag dang rjes su mthun par bri bar dam bca' ba dang*/ sgrub pa po'i mtshan nyid dang*/ bgegs bsal ba dang*/ thab byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ me lha'i mtshan nyid dang*/ mchod yon gyi cho ga dang*/ rdzas dgod pa'i tshul lo// dang po thab khung la gsum/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ thab khung bsdus te bya ba'o// rgyas par bshad pa la bzhi/ dbyibs dang*/ kha dog dang*/ tshad dang*/ dbus su dgod pa la sogs pa'i mtshan ma rgyas pa dang*/ phyogs gang du bya ba'o// dang po la gsum/ thab tu me bsgrub pa dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa dang*/ 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa'o// 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa la bzhi/ me lha dang 'brel ba'i cho ga dang*/ byon zan dbul zhing me pra brtag pa dang*/ rdzas dgram pa dang*/ sbyin sreg gi mchod pa dngos so// dang po la drug dam tshig pa'i me lha bskyed pa dang*/ ye shes pa dgug pa dang*/ byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ dbang bskur zhing mchod la gos bskon pa dang*/ khrus bya ba dang*/ dngos su dbang bskur ba'o// sbyin sreg gi mchod pa la lnga/

dang por gang ba'i sbyin sreg dbul ba dang*/ sbyin sreg gi rdzas dbul ba'i rim pa gang du dbul ba dang bcas pa dang*/ dbul ba'i rim pa sngags dang bcas pa dang*/ rdzas gsang sngags gang gis dbul ba rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ rdzas thams cad bdud rtsis bsre ba'o// dngos gzhi spyi'i don gsum pa la gsum/ mchod bya'i yul dang 'brel pa dang*/ mchod pa dngos dang*/ mthar bya ba'o// dang po la bzhi/ dam tshig pa bskyed pa sngon du 'gro bas ye shes pa spyan drang ba dang*/ thab khung gi g.yas su spyan drang ba'i mchod pa dang*/ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa bsre ba dang*/ dbang bskur zhing go bskon pa'o// mchod pa dngos la drug ye shes sems dpa'i thugs kar lha bskyed pa gang ba'i sbyin sreg dbul ba dang*/ bsreg rdzas rnams bsangs la sbyin sreg rgyas par bya ba dang*/ dgang blugs gsum dbul ba sngon du 'gro bas sbyin sreg bya zhing mchod pa rgyas par bya ba dang*/ rdzas lhag ma gzhan gyis sbyin sreg bya ba dang*/ sbyin sreg gi sngags dang*/ dngos grub kyi sbyin sreg gi rdzas rnams bshad pa'o// mthar bya ba la drug mthar mar gyi dgang blugs dbul zhing mchod pa rgyas pas mchod pa dang*/ bde legs dang bkra shis brjod pa dang*/ bstod cing 'dod pa'i don gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ bzod par gsol zhing gshegs su gsol ba dang*/ gtor ma sbyin pa dang*/ slar yang ye shes sems dpa' chos kyi dbyings su gshegs su gsol ba'o// mjug la drug 'jig rten pa'i me lha lhag mas mchod pa dang*/ 'dod pa'i don gsol ba gdab cing gshegs su gsol ba dang*/ rang lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas phyogs skyong la gtor ma sbyin pa dang*/ yi ge brgya pa gdon pa dang*/ phur bu dang*/ mda' dbyung zhing bkru ba dang*/ bskor ba byas te glu gar sngon du 'gro bas ci bde bar gnas pa'o// sbyin sreg gi bsdus don dge bsnyen grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bgyis so//
// ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
